warnings: The host repeats the same bullish condition several times (three-wave decline, wave 4 then wave 5, higher prices likely while the Thursday low near 83K holds); it is recorded once, in the concluding statement.
The Fibonacci support box (63,326 to 74,800) is described as where a future pullback may stabilize, not as a price target; it is kept in the reasoning of the higher-low claim.
